clarification_of: Previous-word 1MB comparison decision rule; replaces conflated failure verdict before execution.
identity: A_P = A_K byte for byte. Equal lengths alone never establish identity.
missing: Keep unknown results null. Retain complete measurements and all failed-attempt artifacts. A resource violation fails that execution resource gate without proving compression loss. Repeatability failure is recorded separately and blocks confirmation.

outcomes.record: Predictive confirmation on this cold 1MB sample.
outcomes.when: All required checks pass; g_P > 0 and g_S > 0

outcomes.record: Parent improvement observed, but advantage over the delayed control is unconfirmed.
outcomes.when: Valid complete comparison; g_P > 0 and g_S <= 0

outcomes.record: Correctness or control failure; the affected compression inference is invalid.
outcomes.when: Inversion, synchronization, P/K identity or released-D parity fails

outcomes.record: Resource failure or incomplete execution; no complete confirmation verdict.
outcomes.when: Timeout, memory stop or missing required evidence

population.prior_exposure: Previously used by event-parse and parent mechanisms; separate from previous-word development and validation, not globally unseen.

state: Compare authoritative predictive state at every declared boundary: parent pre-truth probability and transition streams, 4096-byte checkpoints, terminal tables/state, parse and update counts; within K/D/S also every reconstructed-byte word-history update and terminal words. P/K compare the parent projection; discarded K bookkeeping need not equal nonexistent P bookkeeping. Experimental/released D compare all state affecting future predictions, with matching complete available witnesses. These are hash witnesses, not full intermediate snapshots.
